Synthetic Oat Bars

Ingredients

  • 2 cups rolled oats
  • 1/2 cup honey
  • 1/4 cup butter, melted
  • Pinch of salt

Directions

  1. Stir the oats, honey, butter and salt in a bowl until evenly coated.
  2. Pick a pan size below *see notes*
    1. Square pan: 9 bars
      • > Press into an 8-inch pan and bake at 350°F (177°C) for 20 minutes.
    2. Sheet pan: 16 bars
      • > Press into a quarter sheet pan and bake at 350°F (177°C) for 15 minutes.
  3. Cool completely in the pan, then cut into bars.

* Notes *

Warm honey mixes in faster than cold honey.

  • Square pan:
    • > Thicker, chewier bars.
  • Sheet pan:
    • > Thinner, crisper bars.
